summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Tenaris SA, a foreign private issuer, to report the results of its Annual General Meeting and Extraordinary General Meeting of shareholders held on May 12, 2026. The meetings approved routine matters: consolidated 2025 financial statements, an annual dividend of $0.89 per share ($1.78 per ADS; ~$0.9B total) with a balance of $0.60 per share payable May 20, 2026, board reappointments including Paolo Rocca as chairman, reappointment of CEO Gabriel Podskubka, appointment of statutory auditor Forvis Mazars, share buyback authorization renewal, and a capital reduction via cancellation of 62,355,174 treasury shares. No M&A, activist, special dividend, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation is present — this is a standard AGM/EGM results filing. There is no transaction for deal terms.
